description: Divide a deceased person's net estate among the heirs under the Civil Code's classes and fixed shares (فروض), with return (رد) and shortfall (ورود نقص; no عول, as in Shia law) and a bequest of up to one third, flagging the rule on a wife's share of land. Use it when the question is who inherits how much; for the articles behind a share use search_iranian_law or get_law_article (قانون مدنی, مواد ۸۶۱ تا ۹۴۹). Give only the living heirs: a later class inherits only when every earlier class is empty, and a spouse inherits with every class. Returns each heir's fraction and amount in rial with the articles applied. Amounts in rial; dates in the Jalali calendar.

bequest_rial.description: A bequest (وصیت) in rial; capped at one third.

full_brothers.description: Brothers of the same father and mother (class 2).

full_sisters.description: Sisters of the same father and mother (class 2).

maternal_siblings.description: Brothers and sisters by the mother only (class 2).

mother_blocked.description: The mother's share is reduced by siblings (حاجب, Civil Code 892): two brothers, four sisters, or a brother and two sisters, with the father alive.

net_estate_rial.description: Net estate in rial, after debts, funeral costs and financial obligations.

spouse.description: The surviving spouse, if any; none when not given. Values: none = ندارد; husband = زوج (شوهر); wife = زوجه (همسر).

wives.description: Number of surviving wives when spouse is wife.
